A '''bipod''' was a two-legged stand that was attached to the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] or a heavy weapon. It steadied the weapon to facilitate aiming and firing. Normally, it was used while prone or adjacent to waist-high or chest-high cover. A bipod could also be used as a mount for heavy weapons such as [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blasters]].<ref name="S&V" />
